entities.name: Philippe Henri Joseph d'Anselme
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philippe Henri Joseph d'Anselme was a French general during World War I and the Southern Russia Intervention. He was the son of Joseph Charles Denis d’Anselme and Louise d’Agoult.
